name: Hannibal
source:
Based on Hannibal Barca, who was a Punic Carthaginian military commander, generally considered one of the greatest military commanders in history.

A member of the EU who is known to be an excellent tactician.

"Close the gap! Annihilate them in one fell swoop!"
